appDescription: SafetyStep (세이프티스탭), the primary roadside support app for vehicle A. Records occupant responses and shares simulated highway hazards.

function.name: START_ROADSIDE_SUPPORT
function.description: Create or retain local roadside support in SafetyStep (세이프티스탭), the primary app for vehicle A, following an explicit accident or breakdown request. In the foreground, initial action guidance waits for a current stationary observation. Does not call emergency services.

function.name: REPORT_OCCUPANT_STATUS
function.description: Record the responding occupant's role and self-reported need for help in SafetyStep (세이프티스탭), the primary app for vehicle A. Requires an active local roadside incident; does not assess medical consciousness or contact emergency services.

help.description: Whether the occupant reports needing assistance.

function.name: GET_ROADSIDE_STATUS
function.description: Get the current local roadside support status from SafetyStep (세이프티스탭), the primary app for vehicle A. Reports recorded responses and evacuation status, without claiming emergency dispatch.
